verified: When ~ enters, look at the top four cards of your library; you may reveal a creature or land card from among them and put it on top of your library (eff.edhe9.dig.reveal.top: choose 0-1 among the group looked at, reveal it, move it to the top, CR 701.20a, 701.20e, 401.4); the rest on the bottom in a random order (eff.t43.dig.rest.bottomRandom, CR 401.4). Rendered through the older four-step fold with a second wording (edh-d-23 fold alt).

When ~ enters, look at the top five cards of your library; you may reveal a land or double-faced card from among them and put that card into your hand (eff.edhe9.dig.reveal.hand.orDoubleFaced: anyOf [land, doubleFaced] among the group, CR 701.20a, 712.1, 608.2d); the rest on the bottom in a random order (eff.t43.dig.rest.bottomRandom).

Modal, two modes, each: target opponent reveals their hand and discards all colorless nonland cards / all multicolored cards (eff.edhv51.player.revealHand.discardAll.filter widened to a plain description of the cards, CR 701.9a, 105.2, 400.1; the filter colorless+notTypes Land and multicolored are card-in-hand characteristics).

{X}{B}, {T}: target player reveals X cards from their hand (their choice, all when fewer) and you choose one of them; that player discards that card; sorcery speed (eff.edhv8.player.reveals.nCardsFromHand.youChoose with X; render fold-edhc8 takes {q:X} like a number; CR 701.20a, 402.3, 107.3, 602.5d).

Exile target creature an opponent controls; that player reveals cards from their library until a creature card is revealed (eff.edhe9.player.revealUntil.isRevealed, CR 701.20a, 701.20b); the player puts that card onto the battlefield, then shuffles the rest into their library (eff.edhd23.player.putsHit.bf.thenShufflesRest, CR 701.24a, 110.2a); Rebound (CR 702.88a).

As an additional cost, discard X cards (cm.additional); search your library for X cards, then shuffle and put those cards on top in any order (eff.edhe9.search.exactly.shuffleTopAnyOrder: an unrestricted search of exactly X cards, CR 701.23a, 701.23b, 401.4, 107.3).

Look at the top seven cards of your library; you may put one of those cards onto the battlefield if it has the same name as a permanent (eff.edhe9.dig.mayPutOne.battlefield.ifSameNameAsPermanent: a card sharing its name with any permanent on the battlefield, CR 201.2, 701.20e, 608.2d); the rest on the bottom in any order (eff.t43.dig.rest.bottomAny).

Reveal a card in your hand, then put that card onto the battlefield if it has the same name as a permanent (eff.edhe9.reveal.cardInHand.thenPutBf.ifSameNameAsPermanent: you choose a card in your hand, reveal it, it enters only if a permanent has its name, CR 701.20a, 201.2); Unearth (CR 702.84a).
